title: Qualify already-opened section-3 commands with a positive/negative matrix
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Already-opened section-3 rows are qualified against the table positive geometry and stated refusals on a 3s A/B/C fixture scaled from the 450-frame examples (divide by 5, still on the 30 fps grid), with planted linear source windows.

Covered: reject MoveClips collision and negative start, SplitClip source remapping, insert paste (including a spanning synced audio split and SYNC_LOCKED), overwrite [120,210), leave-gap lift, ripple close of R=[120,180), ordinary leave-gap trim, ripple trim in/out, includeLinks offset / ignore-links / unlink, copy A+C preserving the relative gap, insert-move leave-gap, and clipLocal/absolute caption and marker follow. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host is still REF_NOT_FOUND. Auto-close is not a MoveClips mode.

A real UI path splits packed A/B/C, previews a colliding +6-frame move (COLLISION, no write), ripple-trims A out by 3 frames, undoes and redoes that command, archives a fork, exports a VTT sidecar, and still refuses preview/MP4 burn-in.

SplitClip and ordinary TrimClip still refuse CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED when captions exist. The table 0.02s AV offset is off the 30 fps grid and currently refuses on relink (OFF_FRAME_GRID); the link example uses one frame (1/30 s) on an unsplit pair.

Already-delivered leave-gap, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen ripple trim, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval / source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, and 1000 seeded random undo stay unchanged. No silent caption or marker drop. No MP4 burn-in. No new persistence table.

Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, caption-aware split/leave-gap trim, or the full section-3 matrix.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 count and XD10 stay separately counted. Intermittent underrun, old-writer schema9 as a product qualification, and other-end GPU physical sync remain unproven.
